name: event_id
description: Client-generated event id used for BigQuery streaming de-duplication.

name: event_date
description: UTC event date, used for partitioning and daily analytics.

name: event_source
description: Source system, for example flutter_app or backend.

name: platform
description: Client platform such as web, android, ios, macos, or windows.

name: app_version
description: App version/build supplied by the client.

name: service_name
description: Backend service name that ingested the event.

name: service_version
description: Backend service revision/version that ingested the event.

name: environment
description: Runtime environment such as development or production.

name: client_schema_version
description: Client analytics payload schema version supplied by the app.

name: data_classification
description: Data handling class. Product analytics rows must not contain raw health content.

name: contains_health_content
description: False when the row contains no raw journal text, audio, transcripts, names, emails, or biometric values.

name: firebase_uid_hash
description: HMAC-SHA256 hash prefix of the Firebase UID. Raw UID is never exported.

name: session_id
description: Ephemeral app session id generated at startup.

name: properties_json
description: Bounded JSON object of primitive privacy-safe event properties.
